title: Minister LeBlanc meets with Advisory Committee on Canada-U.S. Economic Relations
excerpt: The committee convened on October 22, 2026, to discuss the impact of U.S. tariffs on Canadian businesses and sectors.
bodyHtml:
On October 22, 2026, the Honourable Dominic LeBlanc, President of the King's Privy Council for Canada and Minister responsible for Canada-U.S. Trade, Intergovernmental Affairs, Internal Trade and One Canadian Economy, met with members of the Advisory Committee on Canada-U.S. Economic Relations. The meeting included Chief Trade Negotiator Janice Charette and Ambassador Mark Wiseman.

During the session, committee members discussed the ongoing impact of U.S. tariffs on their regions, businesses, or sectors. Participants shared perspectives on Canada’s response to these measures and how they are helping mitigate economic impacts across the country. This meeting marks the ninth time the committee has convened since April 2026.

Chief Trade Negotiator Charette discussed the ongoing work to address unjustified trade measures affecting Canadian workers and businesses. Ambassador Wiseman provided an update on the current state of play in Washington. The discussion underscored the importance of continued collaboration with governments, industry, labour and other partners to ensure Canada’s response reflects national priorities and promotes long-term economic growth.
